definitions.explanation: The building or wing of a larger facility that houses the offices and administrative functions, as opposed to factory, classroom, or laboratory buildings.

examples.japanese: ⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{事務棟|じむとう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The reception is in the office building.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{隣|となり}→隣：01003_tonari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{事務棟|じむとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{建|た}っている→建つ：12544_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: The office building stands next to the factory.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧{事務棟|じむとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{二階|にかい}→二階：27513_nikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}って→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: To complete the paperwork, please first go to the second floor of the administration building.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{事務|じむ}→事務：11418_jimu⟧ (office work, administration) + {棟|とう} (a counter and word for a building or wing). Used on campuses, hospital grounds, and factory sites to name the administrative building.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {事務棟|じむとう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入口|いりぐち}: the entrance to the office building
- ⟦{本部|ほんぶ}→本部：00112_honbu⟧{事務棟|じむとう}: headquarters office building

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧: office — a workplace office in general, not specifically a separate building on a larger site
- ⟦{本館|ほんかん}→本館：21133_honkan⟧: main building — the principal building of a complex, regardless of its function
